lastCompletedStory.title: CRITICAL: The v/V read-only viewer pane now dies immediately, so the feature this whole log exists to serve is broken.

openQuestions: CAM-513 (flaky-test-isolation, filed on main from US-R1-003) remains open and unrelated to this story's diff.

US-R2-003 (viewer freezes permanently after the first rotate, tail -f follows the unlinked pre-rotate inode) is a separate, still-open CRITICAL finding against the same v|V line/buildConfigLogCapCommand family; out of scope for this story (US-R2-002 fixed only the immediate-death race by pre-creating the file) but should be picked up next given priority ordering in prd.json.

US-R2-004 (WARNING: every existing test in test/setup-config-log.test.ts spawns snippets under an explicit bash, never the real /bin/sh production tmux hands pipe-pane -o commands to) is still open; this story's new test spawns buildConfigLogPathAssignment under bash only (matching the existing describe block's convention), it does not add the real-tmux end-to-end integration test US-R2-004 asks for.
US-R2-005 (site 4 has no stale-sibling pruning, unlike sites 1/2/3/5) remains open and untouched by this story.
nextStoryContext: US-R2-002 fixed the reviewer's CRITICAL finding that the v|V read-only viewer pane died immediately: `buildSetupMenuScript`'s viewer line runs `tmux pipe-pane -o '<buildConfigLogCapCommand output>'; tail -f $CAM_CONFIG_LOG` in one shell command, but `buildConfigLogCapCommand`'s writer only creates $CAM_CONFIG_LOG lazily on its first `cat CHUNK >> LOG`, and `pipe-pane` itself never creates the target file (confirmed via Step 5.5 WebFetch against tmux's own manpage: pipe-pane just pipes pane output to a shell command, file creation is the command's job). Combined with US-R1-005's per-pid `$CAM_CONFIG_LOG_DIR/$$.log` path (never a fixed shared path like main's old `/tmp/cam-config.log`, which pre-existed from the second `cam setup` onward and never raced this way) and the EXIT-trap `rm -f`, the file never pre-existed when the viewer pane's `tail -f` started. GNU coreutils' documented default (confirmed via WebSearch against the GNU coreutils manual) is that `tail -f` WITHOUT `--retry` reports a missing file and exits immediately rather than waiting/polling for it to appear -- so the viewer pane's `tail -f` lost this race and the pane died on launch, reproduced by the reviewer under real tmux 3.6a with remain-on-exit on (dead=1, stderr `tail: .../l.log: No such file or directory`) for both a quiet and a noisy config pane. Fix, exactly as the story's own one-line suggestion: `buildConfigLogPathAssignment` (src/commands/setup.ts) now appends `: > "$CAM_CONFIG_LOG"` (POSIX no-op redirection: creates-or-truncates, quote-safe since this line runs in the OUTER menu script context which is a normal double-quoted bash heredoc-like template literal, not the triple-nested zero-quote pipe-pane snippet family US-R2-001/US-R1-004 document) immediately after deriving the per-pid path, so the file always exists (empty) well before the `trap` line installs cleanup and long before the user can ever press `v`/`V` to open the viewer. New regression test (`test/setup-config-log.test.ts`, 'pre-creates the log file itself, before any writer ever runs') runs the real production `buildConfigLogPathAssignment` snippet under real bash with NO writer/cap command ever invoked, and asserts the resulting path exists on disk as an empty (0-byte) file the instant the snippet returns -- proving the pre-creation lives in this function specifically, not incidentally via writer timing. Full bun test 6101 pass / 0 fail (+1 from the new test, up from 6100 at US-R2-001's handoff), typecheck 0 errors, full bun run check:all spine green after one file-size-budget.json raise for src/commands/setup.ts (1044->1059, the doc comment plus the one new line), dated note prepended to the _ref field naming US-R2-002/CAM-510 and staged in the same commit as the code change. No vendor/templates changes, no embed-vendor needed. Step 5.5 fetched the current tmux.1 manpage (confirming pipe-pane does not create files) and searched the GNU coreutils manual (confirming tail -f's default no-wait-if-missing behavior without --retry) -- both align with and fully explain the reviewer's real-tmux repro, no correction needed to the implementation. scripts/cam/prd.json was left untouched/uncommitted by this story, per the AGENT.md rule that the implementer never edits prd.json.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirmed tmux's pipe-pane only pipes pane output to a shell command via /bin/sh -c; it does not create the target file itself, so file pre-existence is entirely the responsibility of the surrounding shell script (buildConfigLogPathAssignment), matching this story's fix.

Confirmed GNU tail -f, without the --retry option, reports a missing file and exits rather than waiting/polling for it to appear -- this is exactly the mechanism behind the reviewer's real-tmux repro of the viewer pane dying immediately, and confirms pre-creating the file (this story's fix) is the correct closure, not a --retry flag change to the tail invocation (which the codebase does not control the availability of across BSD/GNU tail variants anyway).
